key_idea: Give each letter a 5-bit code and ask one query per bit containing all letters with that bit set; the union of answers for a position spells its letter's code.
sketch: Use codes 1..26 (not 0..25) so that every position appears in at least one answer; this also reveals the unknown length as the largest position reported. Five queries, then OR bit b into every reported position and decode. O(5 * |word|). Pitfalls: the length is not given, and with code 0 the letter 'a' would be invisible; remember to flush and to read the final verdict. Interactive, so validated with my own Python interactor on 60 random words (lengths 1 to 10000, including single-letter alphabets), not the sample checker.
